test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a circular race of 625 m, X and Y start from the same point, at the same time and at speeds of 36 km/h and 54 km/h, respectively. When will they meet again for the first time on the track if they are running in the opposite directions?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the track = 625 m

Speed of X = 36 km/h

Speed of Y = 54 km/h

**Concept:**

Time taken to meet when moving in opposite directions = Distance/Relative speed

**Solution:**

Convert speeds from km/h to m/s by multiplying by (5/18)

⇒ Time = 625/((36 × (5/18) + 54 × (5/18)))

⇒ Time = 25 seconds

**Therefore, X and Y will meet again on the track in 25 seconds.**
